info.title: A2Z Tools Public API
info.summary: Free website, DNS, SSL, email-authentication and SEO checks.
info.description: Free API by A2Z Tools (https://a2z.tools). Without a key: 10 calls a minute and 100 a day per IP. With a free key from https://a2z.tools/developers: 60 a minute and 2,000 a day. Send the key in the X-API-Key header. If you show the data publicly, please credit "Data by A2Z Tools" with a link to https://a2z.tools.

tags.name: ssl
tags.description: SSL / TLS: Certificates, expiry, protocols, HSTS, OCSP and certificate transparency.

tags.name: dns
tags.description: DNS: Records, propagation across public resolvers, reverse DNS and DNSSEC.

tags.name: email
tags.description: Email authentication: SPF, DKIM, DMARC, BIMI, MTA-STS and TLS-RPT, separately or as one graded check.

tags.name: domain
tags.description: Domain & IP: WHOIS over RDAP, IP and ASN information, reverse IP.

tags.name: http
tags.description: HTTP & headers: Status, redirects, response headers, security headers, CSP, CORS, cookies, caching and performance basics.

tags.name: seo
tags.description: SEO & crawlers: Open Graph, canonical, hreflang, structured data, robots.txt, sitemaps, llms.txt, AI crawler access and ads.txt.

tags.name: site
tags.description: Site health: One-call health summaries, PWA manifest, favicon, security.txt and front-end dependency checks.
